act_thesis: Discovery becomes pattern, under ordinary friction with no will behind it. A care failure (E01–E02) leaves Seraphine a private rule and a lapse she keeps unsaid; Lucien meets her badly and puts a lie on a legal record (E04), then chooses it again (E10). The strange moves from private perception into public behaviour (E06–E07) until the whole Square goes down at once (E14): undeniable in fact, disputed in cause, with Lucien's name in a policeman's notes. Seraphine and Lucien come to trust each other without fixing each other (E12–E13), and Lucien chooses a person over the proper channel, leaving his letter unsent and calling Baz (E15).

act_success_criteria: E01 gives the mystery human cost before explanation: Dré dies, Seraphine stays with the family, and her part in the lapsed card stays unsaid; no Shard terminology; the swamp is not mythologised; the camp is a Möbius seed of the Mending site only, known to no one, and Dré is not special (source: S1.T1.B01.A1.E01, from v4.1b E01; VAA §3 O1; BC-HONEY-ISLAND-SITE)
E02 separates grief from anomaly; the residue is unnamed (no formal Echo language); her walk on the road is her own test and draws no conclusion (source: S1.T1.B01.A1.E02, from v4.1b E02)
Seraphine has a life and a friend before the mystery: Caro's friendship predates page one, shown by behaviour, with no introduction (source: S1.T1.B01.A1.E03, from v4.1b E03, R31)

Lucien is introduced through his way of seeing, on a legitimate bounded assignment; the lean appears twice (E04, E10), faint and unnamed, with one bearing only; he chooses the lie on the form at E04 and again at E10 (source: S1.T1.B01.A1.E04, S1.T1.B01.A1.E10; BC-SOUTHWEST-LADDER; Q-DR10)
The Vein works as an ordinary room: the scene holds with its anomaly dialogue deleted; she chooses a pleasure and pays no penalty (source: S1.T1.B01.A1.E05; BC-VELVET-VEIN-ROOM)

Public recurrence precedes the civic event: a room of strangers stops and starts together, with no puppets (E06); a repeat at the Square under different circumstances, which her early move makes worse (E07) (source: S1.T1.B01.A1.E06, S1.T1.B01.A1.E07; BC-JACKSON-SQUARE-RETURN)
S02 (inside E07) produces "Was that similar?", not "This is happening globally" (source: S1.T1.B01.A1.E07 S02 spec; BC-REMOTE-SIMILAR, BC-PULSE-NAMING)
E12: neither fixes the other, and their meeting causes nothing in the world. E13: trust appears in behaviour; no romance declaration, no clue (source: S1.T1.B01.A1.E12, S1.T1.B01.A1.E13)

E14 meets its causal card: the whole Square goes down at once, many witnesses, disputed cause; the amp quits and Lucien's check finds no fault; two ordinary recordings exist (aligned only at E17) (source: D1, D2, D3; CC §2; M01; Q-RE2; S1.T1.B01.A1.E14)
E15 traces the Square returning to itself imperfectly, and Lucien admits to Seraphine that the problem is beyond him (source: S1.T1.B01.A1.E15, from v4.1b E16)

Act exit: help is coming; the problem is larger than the people asking; Lucien calls Baz personally rather than his office, the letter unsent for method, not distrust; no death foreshadowing (source: S1.T1.B01.A1.E15; BC-ASKED-HIM-HERE, BC-DOMINION-LADDER)
The Life/Reward units (E03, E05, E11, E13) end on life, not plot (source: S1.T1.B01.A1.E03, S1.T1.B01.A1.E05, S1.T1.B01.A1.E11, S1.T1.B01.A1.E13)
A variety of pleasure and want is visible (amusement, irritation, harmless selfish wants), not only care (source: VAA §4 execution tests)

Act I's friction has no will behind it: each pressure is ordinary and described by its own authority, justification and interests; the Square's policeman keeps his own part (source: Q-XP2; ebci/prose/README.md; S1.T1.B01.A1.E14)

Choices produce consequences: the lapse left unsaid (E01), the lie on the record (E04, E10), the early move at the Square (E07), Lucien's fall in public with his name taken (E14) (source: Q-XP standing test; Q-EN8; TCG §4)
Care may lead a piece; each piece is judged by what a character chooses and changes (source: Q-XP1)
Observation stays apart from conclusion: what anyone perceives stays observation or a character's hypothesis, never a narrated law (source: Q-MO2; S1.T1.B01.A1.E14 engine)
